title: Opinion: California’s AB 496 deadline is fast approaching: How beauty brands can avoid getting caught out
summary: Opinion: With California’s Assembly Bill 496 list of banned cosmetic ingredients taking effect in just five weeks, the beauty industry needs to act now, not wait until the deadline arrives, argues Natalie Vauli, founder at contract manufacturer Vaulabs

extraction.key_fact: 캘리포니아 AB 496 금지 성분 목록 시행이 다가오면서 업계의 선제 대응이 필요하다는 의견이 나왔다.
